title: LLM isolation X2: each LLM child gets an allowlisted environment plus its manifest variables, nothing else
summary: driverEnv starts from os.Environ() (go/internal/bridge/driver_common.go:23-32), envMap too (go/cmd/evolve/cmd_bridge.go:631-640), and tmux new-session has no -e (go/internal/bridge/tmux.go:111,120). CLAUDECODE and CLAUDE_CODE_* of the launcher reach each child. Spec: docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md §6.
fix: Build the child environment from the base allowlist, the manifest env_passthrough (new field) and default_env, plus the pipeline EVOLVE_ markers. Start tmux sessions with explicit -e pairs. Stage shadow: compute both, emit ISOLATION_I2_VIOLATION for each dropped name (never the value), keep today's env. Stage enforce: only the union. Flip process_env_test.go to assert the allowlist.
acceptance: RED first: matrix row N1 (CLAUDECODE=1 on the parent reaches a seat) fails before the change and passes after it at enforce
In shadow, each dropped name emits ISOLATION_I2_VIOLATION with the name and no value
A tmux session gets its environment only from -e pairs; a test with a polluted tmux server proves it
TestProcessEnv asserts the allowlist plus the manifest, not os.Environ()
Changed functions at 100% coverage; spec §6 and the bridge package note updated
